<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
PackPlan(specs: dict[str, evoxc.TensorSpec], entries: dict[str, PackEntry])
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.pack`](/api/evoxc-hf/pack/)

Also available as `evoxc_hf.PackPlan`.

A canonical params tree ⇄ packed graph inputs mapping (family-agnostic).

## Attributes

- `specs` · `dict[str, evoxc.TensorSpec]` — the **packed** params graph inputs (a handful of
  `evoxc.TensorSpec` values, e.g. `{"packed.0": …, …}`).

- `entries` · `dict[str, PackEntry]` — key → `PackEntry` (its packed input and static slice
  position) for every key the plan unpacks — the canonical keys
  (`entry.canonical`) plus any derived, pre-transposed copies
  (`derived_keys`).

## canonical_keys

The canonical parameter keys `pack` takes as input, sorted.

## derived_keys

The derived keys `unpack` yields on top of the canonical ones, sorted.

Each is stored as the transposed copy of its `PackEntry.source`
(empty for a config that needs none, e.g. an untied head).

## has

```python
has(name: str) -> bool
```

Whether `unpack` yields `name` (canonical or derived).

### Parameters

- `name` · `str` — a key to look up.

### Returns

- `bool` — `True` when the plan carries that key.

## input_names

The packed graph input names, in packing order.

## names_by_input

```python
names_by_input() -> dict[str, tuple[str, ...]]
```

Group the canonical keys by packed input.

### Returns

- `dict[str, tuple[str, ...]]` — dict[str, tuple[str, ...]]: packed input name → canonical keys sorted by their axis-0 offset (i.e. concatenation order).

## pack

```python
pack(params: Mapping[str, np.ndarray]) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]
```

Concatenate a canonical host params tree into the packed tree.

One `np.concatenate` per packed input, in deterministic order — no
per-call cost once the packed tree is reused (pack at build/params time,
never per run). A derived entry (a tied head, `PackEntry.source`)
is written as the **transposed** copy of its source array, once, here on
the host.

### Parameters

- `params` · `Mapping[str, np.ndarray]` — canonical params (the exact keys of the family's
  `param_specs` — the canonical tree, never including derived
  keys), host arrays.

### Returns

- `dict[str, np.ndarray]` — dict[str, np.ndarray]: the packed tree (the exact keys of `specs`), each array C-contiguous.

### Raises

- `TypeError` — `params` is not a mapping.

- `HFWeightError` — a key is missing/extra, a value is not a numeric host
  array, or a dtype/shape disagrees with the plan.

## unpack

```python
unpack(packed: Mapping[str, 'evoxc.SymbolicTensor']) -> dict[str, 'evoxc.SymbolicTensor']
```

Slice the packed graph inputs back into the canonical params dict.

Called as the FIRST statement of a family forward body when the graph was
built with `pack_plan=self`: every slice is **static**
(`evoxc.slice(t, start, lengths)`), so the compiled program is identical
to the unpacked one up to a concatenation-free copy.

Derived entries (`derived_keys`, e.g. a tied head stored
pre-transposed) come back as extra keys holding the static slice of the
stored — already transposed — shape; no in-graph transpose is involved.

### Parameters

- `packed` · `Mapping[str, 'evoxc.SymbolicTensor']` — packed params mapping (the exact keys of `specs`) of
  `SymbolicTensor` values inside a trace.

### Returns

- `dict[str, 'evoxc.SymbolicTensor']` — dict[str, evoxc.SymbolicTensor]: the canonical params dict the family forward body expects, plus one entry per derived key (when any).

### Raises

- `TypeError` — `packed` is not a mapping, or a value is not a
  `SymbolicTensor`.

- `HFWeightError` — keys are missing/extra, or a packed input's shape does
  not match the plan (i.e. the caller packed a different config).

## unpacked_keys

Every key `unpack` returns (canonical + derived), sorted.
